title: Evidence package
description: Stage 5 as-of evidence package built by src/evidence.py:build_evidence. Answers 'why is this transfer in the analyst queue?'. Every historical field is computed from rows with ts_n < the transaction's ts_ns only, so a package is byte-identical whether built from the full canonical table or one truncated at the transaction's own timestamp (asserted by tests/test_evidence_leakage.py).

transaction.description: The target transfer, read by canonical row position from data/_trans_canonical.parquet. Identity is never taken from the caller-supplied table, which may be a truncated slice.

row.description: Canonical table row index of the transaction.

date.description: Transaction date, YYYY-MM-DD (canonical table has a 'date' column; null only if absent).

amount_usd.description: Amount in USD from the saved FX tables. The original amount and currency were not carried through to the canonical table and are deliberately not emitted.

golden_label.description: Ground-truth laundering label from the canonical table. Evaluation only - never a model input. null when the 'is_laundering' column is absent.

model.description: Rung 2 (LightGBM + hop features) calibrated score and its alerting position for the scored day. All score-derived fields are null when the row has no saved score.

raw_margin.description: Calibrated Rung 2 score from results/ladder/rung2_lgbm_plus_hop_scores.parquet; null if the row is unscored.

rank_in_day.description: Rank by score among strictly earlier same-timestamp-day rows (earlier = ts_n < this transaction's ts_ns, joined from the canonical table because the scores file has no timestamp). 1 = highest. null if unscored.

threshold.description: That day's budget-derived alert threshold (Nth-highest score for budget N alerts/day); null if no threshold row for the day/budget.

alert.description: raw_margin >= threshold. null when the threshold or score is missing.

budget.description: Analyst alerts-per-day budget used to derive the threshold (default 200).

features.description: The stored 38-column edge feature vector for this row, read from eda_output/features/edge_features_v1.parquet (feature_version in provenance). SHAP drivers are not stored; any driver attribution is re-derivable from this vector. null if the features file is missing or the row is out of range.

context.description: As-of neighbourhood evidence. Every sub-field is computed from rows strictly before the transaction timestamp.

subgraph.description: Two-hop account neighbourhood. inbound_to_sender covers the 2-day window (hop2); outbound_from_receiver covers the 1-day window (hop1). Each list is capped at 20 rows.

hop1.description: Hop-1 look-back window in nanoseconds (1 day).

hop2.description: Hop-2 look-back window in nanoseconds (2 days).

truncated.description: True when a neighbour list hit the 20-row cap (or the sender was itself seen as a counterparty), so the neighbourhood is not exhaustive.

cycles.description: Directed cycles from the sender back to the sender of length 3-6, within one day. Search breaks after the first cycle found, so this is one example path per build, not an exhaustive enumeration.

row.description: Canonical row index of the cycle edge (history edge; strictly earlier than the transaction).

fan_star.description: Sender degree as-of the transaction. Fan-star flags fire at >= 20 counterparties in one direction.

out_degree.description: Distinct outbound transfers from the sender in history.

in_degree.description: Distinct inbound transfers to the sender in history.

chains.description: Account-contiguous chains through this transaction: sender = previous receiver, consecutive hops at most 1 day apart (provenance.chain_definition). prev_hop / next_hop are null when the chain starts / ends at this transaction. this_hop.row is null because the target's row id is transaction.row.

row.description: Always null: the target transfer's id lives in transaction.row.

provenance.description: Where every input came from and what is deliberately missing. known_gaps records absences explicitly so a reader does not read 'absent' as 'zero'.

feature_version.description: Feature table/version, e.g. 'edge_features_v1/v1' from docs/feature_manifest.json ('unknown' if the manifest is absent).

model_version.description: SHA-256 of the per-fold Rung 2 booster used to score the day; null if the booster file is missing.

scored_day.description: YYYY-MM-DD of the scores-file day the row was scored under.

max_hop_gap_ns.description: Maximum gap between consecutive chain hops, nanoseconds (1 day).

known_gaps.description: Deliberate omissions vs the Stage 5 note, dictated by what upstream stages saved.

anyOf.description: As-of sender/receiver history for one account, strictly before the transaction. null when the account has no prior activity.

first_seen_ns.description: Earliest timestamp, epoch nanoseconds, at which the account appears (either side) in history.

amount_mean.description: Mean amount_usd over transfers in this direction; 0.0 when txn_count is 0.

amount_max.description: Max amount_usd in this direction; 0.0 when txn_count is 0.

distinct_counterparties.description: Distinct counterparty accounts (unique, not row count).

cross_bank_frac.description: Fraction of transfers where source bank != destination bank; 0.0 when txn_count is 0.

row.description: Canonical row index of the history edge (never a position within a caller-supplied table).
Canonical row index of the history edge.
